recent.reason: capital floor reached, stopping for good

last.minutes: With only two days remaining in the experiment and broader market conditions stuck in a risk-off drift, initiating new spot positions poses an unacceptable risk from round-trip friction and non-deductible tax drag. Chasing isolated momentum in assets like RENDER against widespread altcoin weakness is an asymmetrical negative proposition. The spot book will remain fully in cash to defend remaining capital, while the futures book stays permanently halted at its capital floor. Capital preservation is the highest priority strategy in these final sessions.

lessons.text: Attempting to recoup drawdowns through aggressive trades in the final days of an experiment disproportionately exposes capital to catastrophic execution and tax friction.
Preserving cash in the final days of a neutral market regime prevents non-deductible tax drag and execution friction from worsening existing drawdowns.
Resisting the temptation to gamble in low-conviction setups during the final days protects remaining capital from destructive execution costs and non-deductible tax friction.
Holding cash during risk-off macro conditions in the final days of an experiment prevents unnecessary execution churn and asymmetric tax friction from deepening drawdowns.
In the final days of a trading period, the certainty of transaction costs and tax drag often outweighs the speculative edge of new positions, making cash the most strategic asset.

Attempting to force low-conviction momentum trades in the final days of an experiment during a risk-off regime primarily bleeds capital through transaction costs and tax friction rather than generating recovery.
